metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience at least 45 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in two specific regions in Queensland between January 27 to February 10, 2019. They want to know if there was at least 45 cm of rainfall (450 mm). Strategy: 1. Use CHIRPS precipitation data which provides daily rainfall estimates 2. Define two regions around Mount Isa and Townsville using buffers around points 3. Filter the collection by date and sum precipitation over the period 4. Check if the total rainfall >= 450 mm (45 cm) for each region 5. If both regions meet the threshold, answer A: Yes, otherwise B: No Data Quality Checks: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate calculations are reasonable (C3) I'll use CHIRPS daily precipitation data and sum over the date range, then check if both regions exceed 450mm. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.4936, -20.7256]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8169, -19.2590]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const collectionSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No precipitation data found for the period."); print("C1"); return; } // Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 3. Processing - Get rainfall for both regions const mountIsaRainfall = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const townsvilleRainfall = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const mountIsaCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const townsvilleCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // 4. Get values and validate const mountIsaVal = mountIsaRainfall.getInfo(); const townsvilleVal = townsvilleRainfall.getInfo(); const mountIsaPixels = mountIsaCount.getInfo(); const townsvillePixels = townsvilleCount.getInfo(); print(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); print(`Mount Isa - Rainfall: ${mountIsaVal?.toFixed(1)} mm, Valid pixels: ${mountIsaPixels}`); print(`Townsville - Rainfall: ${townsvilleVal?.toFixed(1)} mm, Valid pixels: ${townsvillePixels}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mountIsaPixels === 0 || townsvillePixels === 0) { print("No valid pixels in one or both regions."); print("C2"); return; } if (mountIsaVal === null || townsvilleVal === null || isNaN(mountIsaVal) || isNaN(townsvilleVal) || mountIsaVal < 0 || townsvilleVal < 0) { print("Invalid precipitation values calculated."); print("C3"); return; } // Convert mm to cm and check threshold (45 cm = 450 mm) const threshold = 450; // mm const mountIsaMeets = mountIsaVal >= threshold; const townsvilleMeets = townsvilleVal >= threshold; print(`Mount Isa meets 45cm threshold: ${mountIsaMeets}`); print(`Townsville meets 45cm threshold: ${townsvilleMeets}`); if (mountIsaMeets && townsvilleMeets) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
